headline: Oil heads for its third consecutive weekly decline due to Middle East export flows
summary: Oil prices fell on Friday and were on track for a third straight weekly decline, as strong exports from the Middle East weighed on the market.
why: Brent crude is the main global oil benchmark, priced on the ICE exchange in London, and is sensitive to Middle East supply flows.
why_moved: Strong oil exports from the Middle East increased supply, according to the report.
original_headline: Petróleo se dirige a su tercera caída semanal al hilo por los flujos de exportación de Oriente Medio
